newsitem.title: UK: LME copper maintains gain in evening, price firm.
newsitem.headline: LME copper maintains gain in evening, price firm.

text.p: Copper prices continued to make upside headway during Wednesday evening LME trading, notching up further gains in a technical recovery from lows seen at the start of the week, traders said.
They said the market has been underpinned by short-covering, against a background of more interest in the physical sector, although the rally has not changed the overall chart picture.
At 1803 gmt three months was indicated at $1,935/38 a tonne, against the earlier kerb close of $1,925 and Tuesday's levels of $1,870.
The main upside objective is $1,970, although there is likely to be inter-mediate resistance at $1,950, traders said.
Aluminium was aided by copper's trend, and was quoted at $1,435/38 a tonne, up from yesterday's $1,416.50 close.
